ch1.q.text: What makes a connection worth keeping?

ch2.intro.text: Choose a side. You can say, it depends, if you tell us what it depends on. And you can always pass.

ch2.q3.text: Big romantic gestures, or consistent small actions?

ch2.q4.text: More time together, or more personal space?

ch2.t1.text: Would your answer change after five years?

ch2.t2.text: Which would matter more during a disagreement?

ch2.t3.text: Could someone show this in a way you would not immediately recognize?

ch2.t4.text: Would your answer change if one person had a very stressful month at work?

ch3.intro.text: Five useful words and phrases. Watch a short scene, check the meaning, and then talk.

chem.1.text: Wait, you love that author too?

chem.2.text: I could talk about her books all night.

chem.n.text: From the first conversation, there was real chemistry between them.

comm.2.text: We said we would finish it. One more try?

comm.n.text: Even when it was hard, they showed commitment by staying and trying again.

affe.1.text: You always notice when I am cold.

affe.n.text: They are very affectionate with each other.

comp.n.text: Alex wakes up at six. Maya is a night owl. But they are compatible, because they respect each other and want similar things.

work.2.text: I am sorry. I did not realize. Let us talk.

work.n.text: It took time, but they worked things out.

ch4.intro.text: Alex and Maya planned an important evening. Friday, eight o’clock, a table for two.

ch4.r1a.text: At seven fifty-two, Maya’s phone buzzes.

ch4.r1b.text: Can’t make it tonight. Sorry. Let’s talk later.

ch4.r2.text: Across the city, Alex is still at his desk. At five forty-seven, an email arrived: the client moved the deadline to tomorrow morning.

ch4.r3.text: Earlier that week, they had planned the evening by text. Each of them remembered the plan a little differently.

ch5.intro.text: Defend it, then challenge it. Remember: these are debatable opinions, not facts.

ch6.intro.text: Ten tokens. Four qualities. One group decision.

ch6.circ.text: New circumstance. For the next six months, the couple will live in different cities while one of them studies.

ch7.intro.text: Three short cases. Choose a position, then find the one detail that could change your mind.

ch8.intro.text: Would you rather? Choose a door, give a reason, and expect a twist.

ch8.hyp.text: This last one is an imaginative hypothetical.

ch9.intro.text: Make your case. Claim it, face a follow-up, and respond with a target expression.

ch10.intro.text: One last turn. Complete one sentence, then add a final response.
